docs.summary: A way for a graph to ask the world where the ground is, in world space. The engine implements it; Motion only calls it.

members.name: Raycast
members.signature: bool Raycast(Float3 worldOrigin, Float3 worldDirection, float maxDistance, out Float3 worldPoint, out Float3 worldNormal)

docs.summary: Casts a ray and reports what it lands on, or false when it hits nothing.
